reason: Internal tooling and test-naming lint only; no user-observable behaviour changes. `make gate` is `lint typecheck imports test` and `lint` is FIRST, so the 38 ruff errors on master meant the type check, the import contracts and the 7,000-test suite never ran on any invocation of the gate — red since 2026-09-15. 25 of the 38 were N802 objecting to test names that capitalise the load-bearing word (`test_chain_walks_PARENT_LINKS_newest_first`), which is this suite's own convention rather than a defect; N802 is now ignored under `tests/` only, beside the existing N803/N818 allowances, while lowercase function names remain the rule in `nora/`. The other 13 were genuine and mechanical — 8 unsorted import blocks, 2 unsorted `__all__`, 1 unused import, 1 Yoda condition, 1 docstring table row at 105 chars — of which 12 came from `ruff --fix` and one was rewrapped by hand. Nothing in the application changed. Refs #285, which also records that the gate went red because several changes in a row reported it green without running its first step, and that no check yet catches a gate whose failure is stepped over.
